who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane test-selection-wiring pass 2, blaze-merge-1113
what: A test's sandbox trace names what it read, not the bytes; the runner hashes each file when it assembles the trace after the test ends. A file written between the read and that hash was kept under bytes the test never saw, so a later run could report a stale cached pass. Guarded now by Began::moved (stat of every name the read rests on against the run's start, racy window included): such a pass is not kept, NotKept::Moved. The guard is conservative: a test that reads a file it wrote, or one under a directory something else wrote in during the run, is never kept.
cost: a known way to report a stale pass until this pass; now a stat per name and per directory above it for each read of a kept pass
cause: the sandbox records names only, so the hash is taken by someone else, later
class: a fact recorded by name and valued later: the value can be of another moment than the read (build scripts' traces have the same shape, blaze_core::Traced)
prevention: the sandbox records each read's identity as it reads (inode, size and change time, or a hash for small files) so assembly compares instead of re-reading; then Began::moved and its conservatism go
workaround: Began::moved marks the pass not kept by name
fix: partial: the guard; the sandbox-side record is not built
